newsitem.headline: Illinova Corp Q4 net up.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Q4 1996 net income before $100,000 credit from carrying amount for payment of redeemed preferred stock of subsidiary. Q4 1995 net income before $3,500,000 cost for carrying amount for payment of preferred stock.

Q4 1995 net includes $23.0 million $0.30 a share after-tax cost for early retirement and severance. Q4 1995 operating earnings, excluding preferred stock and early retirement and severance costs, were $0.35 a share.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Full-year 1996 net income before $700,000 cost for carrying amount under consideration paid for redeemed preferred stock of subsidiary.

Full-year 1995 net income before $3.5 million or $0.05 a share cost for carrying amount under consideration paid for preferred stock, but includes $23.0 million or $0.30 a share cost for early retirement and severance.
Excluding the costs, full-year 1995 earnings were $2.31 a share.
